# Brian Neher

> > Premier custom portrait painter offering fine art oil paintings, instructional courses, and a comprehensive gallery of commissioned work.

Brian Neher is a professional portrait artist based in North Carolina specializing in custom commission work and classical painting techniques. The site showcases his portfolio, commission process, educational resources, and artist background.
